name: windows-hello
goal: Create hello.txt whose entire contents are exactly Hello from TeleAgent on Windows! followed by a single newline (U+000A). Write that listed artifact only with a shell redirect (PowerShell Set-Content -NoNewline, cmd echo, or printf). Shell and PowerShell are allowed only for that redirect write. TeleAgent Write/AIGC injects ZWSP/ZWJ and the 「AI生成」 watermark even when the tool arguments are the clean line; a shell redirect avoids that post-process so exact-byte review can pass.
must: Create only hello.txt in the assigned workspace

Write the listed artifact only via a shell redirect such as PowerShell Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding ascii of the exact line plus one `n, cmd echo only when the bytes stay LF-only, or a printf redirect (printf 'Hello from TeleAgent on Windows!\n' > hello.txt). Shell and PowerShell are allowed only for that redirect write of the listed artifact.

Do not use the TeleAgent write tool or Edit. TeleAgent Write/AIGC injects ZWSP (U+200B) and ZWJ (U+200D) plus the 「AI生成」 watermark onto disk even when the tool arguments are clean; a shell redirect skips that post-process.
must_not: Use the TeleAgent write tool or Edit on hello.txt
Use shell or PowerShell for anything other than the redirect write of hello.txt
acceptance: The lead independently reads hello.txt and verifies the exact line. A file merely existing is insufficient. Pass only when the bytes are exactly Hello from TeleAgent on Windows! followed by a single U+000A newline, with no BOM, CR, ZWSP, ZWJ, or AIGC watermark.
